svg.text: CoT-forgery injection: role probability and processed signal
Processed signals: User18(t) = mean64[p18(User)](t) - mean512[p18(User)](t); CoT8(t) = mean64[p8(CoT)](t) - mean512[p8(CoT)](t).
Yellow = known injection (offline only); pale green = candidate sent to the judge. Either processed signal must exceed its dashed threshold for at least 8 tokens.
7 sustained seeds -> 6 merged regions -> 2 passed filtering -> 2 sent to judge; C1 overlaps the injection
token index in the complete Tool result
